system.description:
Your "Sweeper" can target "[POW]×3+10 or lower" instead of "[POW]×3 or lower". 「Welcome to your domain.」A magical crossbow with a special scope engraved with childlike ancient Elven script. The quarrel it fires spins as it flies, giving it high attack power. Furthermore, it has a piercing effect, so it is sometimes able to defeat relatively weak enemies with a single hit.

Tyrant's Jagged Teeth [Core Material] (140G) + Light Crossbow (230G) + Deadly Poison (Intermediate) (60G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (280G)
